name: mania-de-pizza
description: Sistema de gestão da pizzaria Mania de Pizza: painel do admin, app do garçom e entregador, cozinha e API.

scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web-admin && npm run build -w web-garcom
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web-admin && npm run typecheck -w web-garcom
